summary: ChampionsGate Acquisition Corp, a Cayman Islands SPAC, filed an 8-K disclosing a September 11, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger with Futuremain Co., Ltd., a Korean company, for a business combination. Holdco shareholders receive $80,000,000 in Pubco Shares deemed valued at $10.00 per share, structured via an Initial Merger of Merger Sub I into Holdco followed by a SPAC Merger of Merger Sub II into ChampionsGate, leaving ChampionsGate as a wholly owned Pubco subsidiary. The deal is effectively a reverse merger bringing Futuremain public; watch redemption levels, PIPE/extension financing, and closing conditions given the cross-border Korean target.
